Key points from the transcript:
1. US market showed mixed flows but Middle East and semiconductor concerns have eased somewhat
2. Friday's drop made the beginning of this week difficult for Korean market, but US market is rebounding led by semiconductors
3. Micron Technology (memory semiconductor related to Korea) fell 13% Friday but rebounded 10%, suggesting similar situation might happen in Korean market today
4. Two factors for US market drop: interest rates and concerns about AI investment contraction due to high rates
5. Google's announcement of continued semiconductor orders to Intel eased concerns despite rising rates
6. Bank of America suggested taking profits, but Park Seok-hyun notes that excluding semiconductors, S&P 500 returns are near zero this year, so it's not necessarily overvalued overall
